Results.ReviewText: My third Weber grill; have been grilling with Weber for the past 40 years.  A little pricier than some, (only reason for 4 stars, rather than 5) , but much better quality, and longer lifespan.  Really like the electronic igniter, the two "flip over" grate surfaces.  Heats up fast, and does a great job on everything from hot dogs to burgers, steak, veggies and seafood.  I live in New England, but grill year-round.  So I like the fact that it has the two large wheels on one end.  That was a huge selling point for me.  May sound trivial, but rolling a grill with castors on grass, or through snow, can be difficult and frustrating.  The large wheels make it easy.  So a great performing grill at a reasonable price (could be $50 cheaper, though).  Recommend it highly!
Results.Title: Great Grill, and No Castors

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill replaced a 23 year old gas grill that I loved. I had trouble getting replacement parts and decided to go with a new one. I was impressed by the reviews of this Weber grill and its 3 burner brother and decided to look at this at a local Ace Hardware store. It was just the right size for my wife and me and it came assembled for free, so I decided to buy it. I am glad I did. So far my first impression after using it about 8 times is that it lights fast with no drama, has an even temperature and appears to be easy to clean. The temperature gauge is helpful in letting me know when to start cooking. The metal seems much thinner on this grill than my older one. I bought a grill cover on Amazon that had a good rating that was about 1/3 the price of the Webber grill cover. For my grill to look good and last for years, I think it is important to always put the cover on it. My last cover lost the velcro straps that kept it from blowing away and I made the mistake of not using it or replacing it which helped to age my old grill.  I plan to take better care of this one.   At the age of 62, I now know my limitations and would only buy a gas grill from a store that would assemble it.  There are enough hassles in life.  No one should have to assemble their gas grill!
Results.Title: This grill is perfect for our needs.

ClientResponses.Response:
We are sorry to hear that you are experiencing difficulty lighting your new grill. Our support team just sent you an email to help get you grilling again. Oftentimes, ignition issues are related to how we light our grills.
 Once you're sure there's no leak in your gas line, these steps can help:


1) Make sure the lid of your grill is open and all the control knobs on the grill are in the OFF position (including the side burner knob, if you have one).

2) Turn on your gas supply by opening the valve on top of the tank.

3) Wait for 60 seconds for pressure to build up in the hose before doing anything. The pressure is going to push the device into place to give it the “all clear” for normal operation. Waiting for the pressure to build up is the most important part of this process.

4) After you’ve waited, go ahead and light your grill as you normally would by turning the appropriate burner one at a time to start/high and hitting the igniter button. 

5) Light all the main burners and set them to high, then close the lid. Give your grill about 10 to 15 minutes and it should be in the 500 to 550 F range, which means your grill is now working properly.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

ClientResponses.Response: We're sorry to hear that your grill is already rusting. Depending on where the rust is, it could be normal. Flavorizer bars will develop surface corrosion due to their exposure to heat and grease. This is expected and does not prevent the bars from turning grease drippings into delicious, smokey flavor. If exterior areas of the grill are corroding, they may be dirty. In that case we recommend cleaning with soap and water, then treating them with a metal polish/rust inhibitor like Noxon-7. We're always here to help and your grill carries a generous warranty against rust-through and burn-through. Please feel free to contact us direct at Support@Weberstephen.com if we can provide further assistance. Thanks and happy grilling!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello! Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are to hear that your experience did not match your expectations. This grill is designed to reach 500 degrees. Next time you use your grill, can you please follow the following steps? 
1. Open the lid
2. Make sure all knobs are in the off position.
3. Fully disconnect your tank from the rubber hose and reconnect it.
4. Open your LP tank slowly fully open.
5. Wait 1 full minute-60 seconds, no longer than 1 minute and 30 seconds. * for best results, please use the timer on your phone. 
6. Turn the first burner to start/high (first position to the left)
7. Hit your igniter
8. Turn on remaining burner
9. Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F
Don't hesitate to get in touch with us if you continue to have issues with this. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
